genshinerc.damageindicator.title: GenshinERC Damage Indicator
Server-authoritative settings controlling broadcast and range
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.enable: Server master switch. When off, damage numbers are not broadcast to any player
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.max_di: Server broadcast range. Players beyond this distance do not receive damage numbers
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.life_t: Total ticks a number survives. Must be an integer
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.gravit: Negative floats up, positive sinks down. Precision 0.01
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.offset: Height offset above entity top, range -2.00 ~ 2.00, precision 0.01
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.size_y: The larger the particle, the higher it spawns. This value increases that effect. Precision 0.01
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.birth_: Random size variation at spawn, 0~0.45, precision 0.01
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.absorb: Fixed color for absorption hearts and absorption recovery
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.shadow: Shadow color. Multiplied with text color,Only luminance channel.
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.z_offs: Prevents Z-fighting flicker between overlapping quads. Negative pushes toward camera. Range -0.15 ~ 0.15, precision 0.01
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.partic: Minimum distance between consecutive damage numbers on the same entity. Prevents overlap. Range 0.00 ~ 2.00, precision 0.01
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.number: Decimal places shown on damage numbers
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.life_s: Shrink to 0 at the end of lifetime
Ticks before despawn to start shrinking. Clamped if it exceeds lifetime
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.life_f: Alpha goes to zero at the end of lifetime
Ticks before despawn to start fading. Clamped if it exceeds lifetime
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.birth_: Particle scales from 0 to target at spawn. Skipped if lifetime shrink start tick is smaller than birth duration
Ticks to scale from 0 to target
Particle alpha goes from 0 to 1 at spawn. Skipped if lifetime fade start tick is smaller than birth duration
Ticks for alpha to go from 0 to 1
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.kill_e: Extra lifetime ticks for the killing blow number. Added on top of base lifetime
genshinerc.config.title: Genshin ERC Config
genshinerc.bar.group.title: Status Bar Settings
genshinerc.bar.group.desc: Configure the health bars above entities
genshinerc.bar.config.y_offset.desc: Adjust height above the entity's head
genshinerc.bar.config.ally_color.desc: Fill color for allies and neutral mobs
genshinerc.bar.config.u0.desc: Left crop point for the atlas (0.0 - 1.0)
genshinerc.bar.config.v0.desc: Top crop point for the atlas (0.0 - 1.0)
genshinerc.bar.config.u1.desc: Right crop point for the atlas (0.0 - 1.0)
genshinerc.bar.config.v1.desc: Bottom crop point for the atlas (0.0 - 1.0)
genshinerc.bar.config.max_distance.desc: Entities beyond this distance will not render health bars
genshinerc.bar.config.height_scale_facto: The higher the entity's bounding box, the more Y offset is applied
genshinerc.bar.config.bbox_size_factor.d: The wider the entity, the larger the bar scales based on its base size
genshinerc.bar.config.base_size.desc: Base scale factor of the bar
genshinerc.bar.config.uv_size.desc: Total height of the texture atlas
genshinerc.bar.config.player_mode.desc: Configure when to show player health bars
genshinerc.bar.config.show_full_health_m: If enabled, mobs at full health will also show health bars
genshinerc.bar.config.overlay_extend_tim: Time for the white overlay to extend
genshinerc.bar.config.overlay_shrink_tim: Time for the white overlay to shrink
Time for the white overlay to fade out
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.z_rand: Lower bound of random offset toward camera on spawn. Negative pushes into the entity. Range -1.00 ~ 1.00, precision 0.01
genshinerc.bar.config.bar_padding.desc: Padding used to avoid transparent areas on the texture edges
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.z_rand: Upper bound of random offset toward camera on spawn. Positive pushes toward the camera. Range -1.00 ~ 2.00, precision 0.01
genshinerc.bar.config.base_length.desc: The initial length of the health bar
genshinerc.bar.config.base_width.desc: The initial width of the health bar
genshinerc.bar.config.height_length_fact: How entity height affects the bar length
genshinerc.bar.config.height_width_facto: How entity height affects the bar width
genshinerc.bar.config.bbox_length_factor: How entity size affects the bar length
How entity size affects the bar width
genshinerc.damageindicator.config.z_offs: Extra push distance of fire particles toward the camera when the entity is on fire, to avoid occlusion by flame billboards. Range 0.00 ~ 1.00, precision 0.01.
genshinerc.bar.config.y_offset_height_fa: Extra Y offset added based on entity height
Duration to show HUD after health changes
genshinerc.bar.config.death_fade_delay.d: Time to stay fully opaque after death
genshinerc.bar.config.fade_in_time.desc: Fade in duration when HUD appears
genshinerc.bar.config.fade_out_time.desc: Fade out duration when HUD disappears
genshinerc.bar.config.mob_mode.desc: Controls how the HUD shows for mobs
genshinerc.bar.config.player_overlay_shr: Higher is slower. Adapts to large health drops automatically.
genshinerc.bar.config.mob_overlay_shrink: White shrink factor for non-player entities.
genshinerc.bar.config.white_easing.desc: Animation curve for the white overlay (Default: EaseOutCubic)
genshinerc.bar.config.small_change_durat: Duration of the flash on small damage
genshinerc.bar.config.shake_duration.des: Total duration of the hit shake
genshinerc.bar.config.fatal_shake_multip: Extra amplitude multiplier when taking fatal damage
genshinerc.bar.config.small_change_enabl: Remaining health flashes white on small damage
genshinerc.bar.config.small_change_thres: Damage below this ratio only flashes white (Default 3.0%)
genshinerc.bar.config.fatal_shake_min_pe: Minimum amplitude percentage of max health for fatal shake
genshinerc.bar.config.fatal_shake_max_pe: Maximum amplitude percentage of max health for fatal shake
genshinerc.bar.config.entity_y_offsets.d: Click to edit. Format: [EntityID Space Offset], e.g., minecraft:witch 0.45. Offset is the Y-axis height in blocks, limited from -10.0 to 10.0. Use + to add rows and trash can to delete.Float Number Type.
genshinerc.bar.config.death_fade_out_tim: Time in seconds for the health bar to fade out after death. Range 0.10 ~ 2.00
genshinerc.bar.config.player_bar_length_: Applies only to players. Adds to the calculated bar length. Range -1 ~ 1, step 0.01, default 0.
genshinerc.bar.config.player_bar_width_b: Applies only to players. Adds to the calculated bar width. Range -0.25 ~ 0.25, step 0.01, default 0.
genshinerc.bar.config.player_bar_y_offse: Applies only to players. Adds to the bar's Y-axis offset. Range -1.5 ~ 1.5, step 0.01, default 0.
genshinerc.bar.config.player_bar_opacity: Applies only to players. The final bar opacity (fade-in, fade-out, and idle) is multiplied by this value. Range 0 ~ 1, default 1.
genshinerc.bar.config.entity_bar_length_: Applies only to non-player entities. Adds to the calculated bar length. Range -1 ~ 1, step 0.01, default 0.
genshinerc.bar.config.entity_bar_width_b: Applies only to non-player entities. Adds to the calculated bar width. Range -0.25 ~ 0.25, step 0.01, default 0.
genshinerc.bar.config.entity_bar_y_offse: Applies only to non-player entities. Adds to the bar's Y-axis offset. Range -1.5 ~ 1.5, step 0.01, default 0.
genshinerc.bar.config.entity_bar_opacity: Applies only to non-player entities. The final bar opacity (fade-in, fade-out, and idle) is multiplied by this value. Range 0 ~ 1, default 1.
genshinerc.bar.config.entity_y_offsets.e: The current configuration contains format errors. Invalid entries will have no effect.
genshinerc.bar.config.small_change_fade_: Time for the hit flash to fade in. Unit: seconds.
Time for the hit flash to fade out. Unit: seconds.
genshinerc.bar.config.small_change_use_s: When shaders are detected, the rendering pipeline overrides alpha. Forces instant flash and disables fades.
genshinerc.bar.config.small_change_shade: How long the flash remains fully opaque in Shader Compatibility Mode. Unit: seconds.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_direction.des: Controls the direction of the buff icons. Right-to-Left expands to the left, Left-to-Right expands to the right.
genshinerc.bar.config.hud_offset_x.desc: Distance from the entire status panel (buffs, level, elements) to the left/right screen edge.
genshinerc.bar.config.hud_offset_y.desc: Distance from the entire status panel to the bottom of the screen. Higher values move it down.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_spacing.desc: Horizontal pixel gap between each buff icon.
genshinerc.bar.config.max_buffs.desc: Maximum number of buffs to display at once. Extras will be hidden.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_offset_x.des: Horizontal tweak of the Lv. text relative to the panel center.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_offset_y.des: Vertical tweak of the Lv. text relative to the panel bottom.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_box_size.d: The size (in pixels) of the element status box.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_spacing.de: Pixel gap between each element box when multiple are present.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_offset_y.d: Vertical height tweak of the element status boxes relative to the panel bottom.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_scale.desc: The scale size for rendering the Lv. text.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_render_backgr: Toggle whether the default dark box behind buff icons is rendered.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_background_al: Controls the opacity of the background box when rendered.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_opacity.desc: Controls the overall opacity of the buff icons.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_blink_rate.de: How many ticks between each blink when the buff is about to expire.
genshinerc.bar.config.hud_color_mix.desc: Mix ratio between grayscale original and configured color (0 = grayscale, 1 = full color).
genshinerc.bar.config.level_offset_z.des: Depth offset of the level text.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_shadow_offse: X offset of the level shadow.
Y offset of the level shadow.
Z offset of the level shadow to reduce Z-fighting.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_shadow_color: Custom color for the level text shadow.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_shadow_alpha: Custom alpha for the level text shadow.
Color when player level is >5 levels above the mob.
Color when mob is -5 to +3 levels relative to player.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_color_yellow: Color when mob is +4 to +8 levels relative to player.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_color_orange: Color when mob is +9 to +12 levels relative to player.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_color_red.de: Color when mob is +13 to +17 levels relative to player.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_color_dark_r: Color when mob is +18 or more levels relative to player.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_offset_z.desc: Depth offset for buff icons to fix Z-fighting or occlusion.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_offset_z.d: Depth offset for element icons to fix Z-fighting or occlusion.
Controls the relative scale of a single buff icon.
genshinerc.bar.config.buff_list_scale.de: Controls the overall scale of the entire buff list, anchored at the bottom-right.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_shadow_enabl: Toggle whether the level text shadow is rendered.
genshinerc.bar.config.level_shadow_brigh: 0 = pure text color, 1 = pure black, values in between blend smoothly.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_min_opacit: Opacity of the element icon and gauge at zero gauge. Opacity rises linearly to 100% at 4.0 gauge.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_gauge_widt: Width of the gauge bar above each element icon, as a percentage of the icon size.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_gauge_heig: Height of the gauge bar, as a percentage of the icon size.
Space between the top of the icon and the gauge bar, as a percentage of the icon size. Negative values overlap the icon.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_gauge_bg_b: Brightness of the gauge background relative to the element colour.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_gauge_anim: Seconds the gauge bar takes to ease to a new value after it is applied or consumed.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_low_gauge_: Below this gauge the element flickers, faster as it approaches zero.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_flicker_mi: Lowest opacity reached during the low-gauge flicker.
Flickers per second when the gauge first drops below the threshold.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_flicker_ma: Flickers per second just before the gauge reaches zero.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_flash_in_t: Seconds for a reacted element to turn white.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_flash_hold: Seconds the element stays fully white before returning to its colour.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_flash_out_: Seconds for a reacted element to return from white to its colour.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_ghost_fade: Seconds a fully consumed element takes to fade out while white.
genshinerc.bar.config.element_slot_slide: How quickly the remaining element icons slide together when one disappears.
genshinerc.bar.config.sub_bar_width.desc: Width of the shield and Zhen-Mie bars as a percentage of the HP bar width.
Height of the shield bar as a percentage of the HP bar height.
genshinerc.bar.config.zhen_mie_bar_heigh: Height of the Zhen-Mie bar as a percentage of the HP bar height.
genshinerc.bar.config.sub_bar_gap.desc: Gap between the HP bar and the sub-bars.
genshinerc.bar.config.sub_bar_fill_speed: How fast the shield and Zhen-Mie bars ease to a new value.
genshinerc.bar.config.sub_bar_white_hold: Seconds the white trail holds before draining.
genshinerc.bar.config.sub_bar_white_drai: How fast the white trail drains after the hold.
genshinerc.bar.config.sub_bar_flash_time: Seconds the bar stays white after being hit.
genshinerc.bar.config.shield_bg_brightne: Brightness of the shield bar background.
genshinerc.bar.config.shield_bg_alpha.de: Opacity of the shield bar background.
genshinerc.bar.config.zhen_mie_buff_cycl: How fast the buffed colours cycle.
genshinerc.bar.config.zhen_color.desc: Colour of the left side of the Zhen-Mie bar.
genshinerc.bar.config.mie_color.desc: Colour of the right side of the Zhen-Mie bar.
genshinerc.bar.config.zhen_buff_color.de: Secondary colour when the Zhen buff is active.
genshinerc.bar.config.mie_buff_color.des: Secondary colour when the Mie buff is active.
genshinerc.bar.config.rpg_hud_enabled.de: Replaces vanilla health, hunger, air and XP with the RPG panel.
genshinerc.bar.config.rpg_hide_ef_hud.de: Hides Epic Fight's battle-mode HUD while the RPG HUD is on.
genshinerc.bar.config.rpg_hud_offset_x.d: Distance from the left screen edge.
genshinerc.bar.config.rpg_hud_offset_y.d: Distance from the bottom screen edge.
genshinerc.bar.config.rpg_model_zoom.des: 1 shows the full body; higher values zoom toward the upper body.
